description: This file contains utility functions for processing throughput data, including formatting data rates, calculating data rates between measurements, formatting timestamps, preparing chart data, and determining appropriate units for display.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts a data rate in bytes per second to a human-readable format with appropriate units (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps).

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Calculates the data rate (rx and tx) per second between current and previous cumulative byte counts, handling counter resets.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp number into a HH:MM:SS string.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares data for chart visualization from a series of throughput data points, generating labels and datasets.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Determines the most appropriate unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps) for the y-axis based on current maximum data rates.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts a data rate in bytes per second to a specified target unit for consistent display.

ctags.name: convertToUnit
ctags.pattern: /^export const convertToUnit = (bytesPerSecond: number, targetUnit: string): number => {$/
